decisions.statement: The totals a task states are the totals of its lines added up.
A task naming no completion card is passed over.
A task the index does not name is passed over.
The id a character's line already had is kept rather than minted again.
A line naming a character no line named before is given an id as it lands.
A line that will not parse is passed over rather than throwing.
The lines are ordered as the reading ordered them.
Nothing here reads or writes a file.

definition: what each character has done of a task, recomputed from completion
